items.description: Implement deterministic Breakout rules, three layouts, controls, and meaningful tests while preserving existing tests.
items.verify: Run the complete suite with required nonempty Breakout engine/layout/UI groups. Check collision, one-time scoring, lives, legal full-clear replays, earned transitions, timing, restart, and existing behavior; report skips.

items.description: Prove the actual terminal game supports input, pause, resize recovery, restart, and clean exit.
items.verify: Run the real PTY harness at supported and undersized dimensions, including resize while paused. Assert unchanged simulation during freezes, no catch-up penalty, and restored terminal state; retain transcript.

items.description: Record Jon's play feedback and any remaining game-feel uncertainty.
items.verify: Launch python3 -m tink_breakout; record Jon's actual feedback and resulting changes, or explicitly record that human playtesting is pending. Pending is not acceptance of difficulty, fairness, or layout quality.

items.description: Record the fresh-agent continuation result and leave an accurate linked handoff.
items.verify: A fresh build agent starts with handoff.md and saved links, identifies scope, actual permission, current evidence and next work, and records omissions/repeated work/user context needed. Refresh evidence before delivery; preserve dated observations and a live status command.
